name: Tm Gantt
pitch: Explore project schedules on one shared timeline in Qlik Cloud.
question: What is planned, and where do Activities overlap?
useWhen: Compare schedules with start and end dates.
features: Show Activities, milestones, and summaries on one time axis.
Group schedules with collapsible levels and clear row structure.
Place overlapping Activities in separate lanes on the same row.
Select Activities with the pointer, keyboard, or touch in Qlik.
